reviews.title: Fun until
reviews.text: Played quite a bit and it was fun until you started forcing ads. In the game you give the option to watch an ad for extra gold which is fine but when you chose then option to not watch ad’s you force an ad. That’s a deal breaker. So I deleted it.

reviews.title: Hate the lives
reviews.text: I hate it that it has lives, and you have to use coins to remove boxes instead of watching ads. I am considering removing the game and find something similar and better.

reviews.title: Lumber flow
reviews.text: Makes you use up all your free passes. As soon as you earn anything it will change the structure forcing you to use up your prizes to continue and win a level. Kind of evil to do to someone. Great graphics and fun to play except for that one nuisance.

reviews.title: Fun but flawed
reviews.text: I’m enjoying playing this game, cute concept but I’m in the early stages. The main problem I have is you play a level, strategic choices are everywhere, trying to bring up what you need to help you. When that choice becomes a guess at the end, that guess ruins it, the whole stage because if you guess wrong, either power up or start all over. It sucks to have all those choices come down to a left or right or middle, zero skill choice. could’ve been a really fun strategy game.

reviews.title: Flow game
reviews.text: Fun, enjoy playing when I have nothing better to do

reviews.title: Amazing game
reviews.text: A very interesting, fantastic game, super fascinating, beautiful graphics, I highly recommend it to players who like such games. Best regards to the author or authors. Thanks, it's a break from reality. It's great, it's the best of the best. The music is phenomenal, it's wonderful, it calms me down. I give it five stars because it's super great. I recommend it to all players again. It's delicious. It's phenomenal. I highly recommend this beautiful game again.
